design_detail: EU own resource based on a progressive wealth tax for individuals or private households (A9-0155/2023 Amendment 2)
source_title: European Parliament roll-call vote 129, 10 May 2023: A9-0155/2023 Amendment 2
grading_note: Named in the affirmative roster (196 for, 383 against) of Amendment 2, which calls on the Commission to propose a new own resource based on a wealth tax for individuals or private households (paragraph 29a, amendment text read in the archived original).

design_detail: asset taxes (varamaksud) and taxes on rich people, 'in the long run'
quote_original: Pikaajaliselt kindlasti. Ma arvan varamaksud, jõukate, rikaste inimeste või ettevõtete maksud – Eesti sellest ei pääse.
quote_en: In the long run certainly. I believe that asset taxes, taxes on wealthy, rich people or businesses - there's no escaping it for Estonia.
source_title: Läänemets: pikas vaates Eesti vara- ja rikaste maksudest ei pääse
grading_note: Speaker's own words to ERR as SDE chair and interior minister. 'Varamaksud' can cover property taxes and he names no base, rate or threshold, so grade C; he links it to a progressive income tax in the same breath.

design_detail: wealth taxes (varamaksud) in place of a progressive income tax; no rate or threshold
quote_original: Varamaksud seevastu on oma olemuselt proportsionaalsed või progresseeruvad rikkuse suhtes ning tabavad peamiselt jõukamaid inimesi, aidates ebavõrdsust vähendada.
quote_en: Wealth taxes, by contrast, are by their nature proportional or progressive with respect to wealth and mainly hit the better-off, helping to reduce inequality.
source_title: Kerly Randlane: maksustame rikkust, mitte edukust
grading_note: Opinion piece titled 'Tax wealth, not success' arguing for wealth taxes by name (and against a progressive income tax); gives no design, so grade B.

design_detail: Solidarity levies on high levels of wealth and international discussions for a progressive wealth tax (A9-0336/2023 Amendment 2)
source_title: European Parliament roll-call vote 62, 12 December 2023: A9-0336/2023 Amendment 2
grading_note: Named under In favour (Renew list) in vote 62 of 12 December 2023 (232 for, 331 against). Position FOR confirmed on howtheyvote.eu (vote 162327). Quote is the surname as the roll call prints it.

design_detail: astmeline varamaks kõige jõukamale osale ühiskonnast
quote_original: vähendame varalist ebavõrdsust, kehtestades pärandimaksu, luksuskaupade maksu ja kõige jõukamale osale ühiskonnast astmelise varamaksu;
quote_en: we reduce wealth inequality by introducing an inheritance tax, a luxury goods tax, and a progressive wealth tax for the wealthiest part of society;
grading_note: Official general party programme (section 9.3) formally adopting an explicit progressive wealth tax (astmeline varamaks) on the wealthiest part of society.

design_detail: 1% (or 0.5%) per year on all wealth exceeding 10 million euros
quote_original: Kuidas näiteks oleks, kui meil maksustada kõik vara, mis ületab 10 miljonit eurot, 1%ga aastas? Või esialgu poole protsendiga?
quote_en: How would it be, for example, if we taxed all wealth exceeding 10 million euros at 1% per year? Or initially at half a percent?
source_title: Indrek Neivelt: Eesti iganenud maksusüsteem tuleks pöörata näoga tulevikku
grading_note: Address delivered at the Riigikogu sitting on the future of the tax system, explicitly proposing an annual net wealth tax of 1% or 0.5% on wealth exceeding 10 million euros.

design_detail: wealth taxes (varamaksud) to increase competition and reduce regressivity
quote_original: Pärandi- ja varamaksud on kõige kapitalistlikumad maksud üldse, sest need suurendavad konkurentsi.
quote_en: Inheritance and wealth taxes are the most capitalist taxes of all, because they increase competition.
source_title: Klassistumist aitaks pidurdada tark kultuuripoliitika. Intervjuu Rainer Katteliga
grading_note: Long-form published interview in cultural newspaper Müürileht advocating wealth taxes by name to curb inequality and increase competition, without rate or threshold.

design_detail: capital or wealth tax (kapitali- ehk nn rikkusemaks)
quote_original: Rikkuse kontsentratsiooni vähendamiseks ja ühiskonna solidaarsuse suurendamiseks tuleb evitada kapitali- ehk nn rikkusemaks.
quote_en: To reduce the concentration of wealth and increase social solidarity, a capital or so-called wealth tax must be introduced.
source_title: Toomas Peterson: uus maksusüsteem - milleks ja kellele?
grading_note: Published op-ed on ERR calling by name for introducing a capital or wealth tax (rikkusemaks) without specifying rate or threshold.
